title: Harnessing Technology for Better Road Safety Outcomes in Singapore
what_it_is: Harnessing Technology for Better Road Safety Outcomes in Singapore

sections.label: Road deaths first three months
sections.summary: In the first three months of this year, there were 19 people like the speaker's friend Mani and two pillion riders like his grandfather.

sentences.speaker: Mr Murali Pillai (Bukit Batok)
sentences.text: For the first three months of this year alone, there are 19 people like my friend Mani, and two, like his grandfather, the pillion rider.

sections.label: Global road injury economic burden
sections.summary: A 2019 Lancet paper estimates fatal and non-fatal road injuries cost the world US$1.6 trillion for 2015-2030.

sentences.speaker: Mr Murali Pillai (Bukit Batok)
sentences.text: Based on a 2019 research paper entitled "The Global Macroeconomic Burden of Road Injuries: Estimates and Projections for 166 countries" published in The Lancet, both fatal and non-fatal injuries are estimated to cost the world US$1.6 trillion for the period 2015-2030.

sections.label: Singapore road fatality rate 2019
sections.summary: WHO figures put Singapore's 2019 road traffic fatality rate at 2.09 per 100,000 population, among the world's lowest.

sentences.speaker: Mr Murali Pillai (Bukit Batok)
sentences.text: Based on WHO figures, Singapore's road traffic fatality rate per 100,000 population, or RTF rate, for 2019 was reported at 2.09, which was amongst the lowest in the world.

sections.label: Motorcyclist share of fatalities
sections.summary: Between 2018 and 2022, motorcyclists and pillion riders made up 50.7% of road traffic fatalities.

sentences.speaker: Mr Murali Pillai (Bukit Batok)
sentences.text: Between 2018 and 2022, motorcyclists and pillion riders accounted for 50.7% of road traffic fatalities.

sections.label: RAG right-turn signal accident reduction
sections.summary: A 2022 PQ reply stated non-discretionary Red Amber Green right-turn signals at higher-risk junctions reduced accidents by 40%.

sentences.speaker: Mr Murali Pillai (Bukit Batok)
sentences.text: For instance, pursuant to a PQ that I filed in 2022, the hon Minister informed that the introduction of the non-discretionary Red Amber Green (RAG) right-turn signals at junctions where there is a higher risk of accidents has reduced instances of accidents by 40%.

sections.label: Vehicle crash avoidance technologies
sections.summary: A 2019 article estimated three crash avoidance technologies could prevent up to 1.6 million US crashes yearly, and ASEAN NCAP and 2022 vehicle safety requirements are described.

sentences.speaker: Mr Murali Pillai (Bukit Batok)
sentences.text: In a 2019 article entitled "Net-societal and net-private benefits of some existing vehicle crash avoidance technologies", it was estimated that just three technologies, namely, blind-spot monitoring, lane departure warning and forward-collision warning for all light-duty passenger vehicles in the US would have collectively prevented up to 1.6 million crashes a year, including 7,200 fatal crashes.

sentences.speaker: Mr Murali Pillai (Bukit Batok)
sentences.text: The ASEAN NCAP, which stands for New Car Assessment Programme, is a body dedicated to elevate vehicle safety standards and encourage a market for safer vehicles in the region.

sentences.speaker: Mr Murali Pillai (Bukit Batok)
sentences.text: It opined that if all cars are equipped with blind-spot detection and visualisation technologies, it is expected that 37% of collisions, especially with motorcycles, can be avoided.

sentences.speaker: Mr Murali Pillai (Bukit Batok)
sentences.text: From 2022, all motor vehicles, including trucks, buses, vans and cars, will have to be compulsorily equipped with safety features that include intelligent speed assistance – basically, this works as speed limiters; reversing detection system; advanced driver distraction warning system; emergency stop signals; reversing detection systems; event data recorders; and accurate tyre pressure monitoring.

sections.label: Insurance premiums and safety features
sections.summary: Underwriters said safety features are considered in assessing premiums, and some insurers discount premiums 4% for dashcams.

sentences.speaker: Mr Murali Pillai (Bukit Batok)
sentences.text: Furthermore, I had occasion to speak to several motor vehicle insurance underwriters who informed me that the presence of safety features in motor vehicles are factors that are taken into account when assessing the premiums payable even though the weight placed on such factors differ from insurer to insurer.

sentences.speaker: Mr Murali Pillai (Bukit Batok)
sentences.text: There are a number of insurance companies in Singapore offering to discount motorists' premiums by 4% just by installing dashcams in their cars.

sections.label: Mandating safety technologies in vehicles
sections.summary: Only 22% of buses are five years old or younger, and the speaker urges LTA to consider mandating safety technologies in all vehicles.

sentences.speaker: Mr Murali Pillai (Bukit Batok)
sentences.text: Based on my calculations, only 22% of buses are five years old or younger.

sentences.speaker: Mr Murali Pillai (Bukit Batok)
sentences.text: Having regard to the developments that I have outlined, I would like to make a case for LTA to consider mandating the incorporation and use of safety technologies that have an established record of being able to reduce collisions in all our vehicles.

sections.label: Speed limiters for heavy lorries
sections.summary: It was announced that all lorries with maximum laden weight exceeding 3,500 kilogrammes must be equipped with speed limiters.

sentences.speaker: Mr Murali Pillai (Bukit Batok)
sentences.text: More recently, in the discussion on safety in workers' transportation, it was announced that all lorries with a maximum laden weight exceeding 3,500 kilogrammes will be required to be equipped with speed limiters.

sections.label: Blind-spot mirrors and cameras
sections.summary: LTA mandated blind-spot mirrors for heavy vehicles in 2015 and allowed camera devices to cover blind-spot areas.

sentences.speaker: The Senior Minister of State for Transport (Dr Amy Khor Lean Suan)
sentences.text: For heavy vehicles, LTA has mandated blind-spot mirrors and allowed the use of camera devices to cover blind-spot areas in 2015.

sections.label: Collision Warning System in buses
sections.summary: 79% of public bus fleets are already fitted with the Collision Warning System.

sentences.speaker: The Senior Minister of State for Transport (Dr Amy Khor Lean Suan)
sentences.text: In fact, for the Collision Warning System, 79% of the public bus fleets are already fitted with that.

sections.label: Senior pedestrian accidents in Silver Zones
sections.summary: Road accidents involving senior pedestrians have dropped by about 80% in completed Silver Zones.

sentences.speaker: The Senior Minister of State for Transport (Dr Amy Khor Lean Suan)
sentences.text: With these improvements, the number of road accidents involving senior pedestrians has dropped by about 80% in completed Silver Zones.

sections.label: Friendly Streets pilot programme
sections.summary: Friendly Streets are called friendly for all users, and pilots are to be completed by 2025.

sentences.speaker: The Senior Minister of State for Transport (Dr Amy Khor Lean Suan)
sentences.text: That is why we call such streets Friendly Streets – friendly for all who use these streets – drivers, pedestrians, residents alike.

sentences.speaker: The Senior Minister of State for Transport (Dr Amy Khor Lean Suan)
sentences.text: We have just started this journey, with pilots to be completed by 2025.

sections.label: Road Traffic Act penalty amendments
sections.summary: MHA amended the Road Traffic Act in 2019 and 2021 to enhance penalties against irresponsible driving and will continue to review them.

sentences.speaker: The Senior Minister of State for Transport (Dr Amy Khor Lean Suan)
sentences.text: MHA amended the Road Traffic Act in 2019 and 2021 to enhance penalties against irresponsible driving and will continue to review them to strike a balance between deterrence and proportionality.

sections.label: Red light cameras and safety technology
sections.summary: With 12 more red light cameras in 2020, Singapore now has 252, up from 120 in 2015, and LTA will monitor technology trends.

sentences.speaker: The Senior Minister of State for Transport (Dr Amy Khor Lean Suan)
sentences.text: With the addition of 12 more red light cameras in 2020, there are now a total of 252 red light cameras in Singapore, up from 120 in 2015, to bolster islandwide enforcement.

sentences.speaker: The Senior Minister of State for Transport (Dr Amy Khor Lean Suan)
sentences.text: LTA will continue to monitor international technology trends, engage the industry and road users and push the envelope in adopting vehicle safety technologies.
